# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

**My pick for most people: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), $54.99**
- It's 0.34" thick and 4.3 oz, with 5,000mAh and Qi2-certified 15W wireless charging. Anker markets it as a fit for the iPhone 17 series.
- 9to5Mac's reviewer has used it and says it feels premium, runs cooler than competitors, and is the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery.
- Buy: https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank
- Caveat: 5K gives roughly 60-75% of a recharge (Macworld), and 15W is below the iPhone 17's 25W maximum.

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5,000mAh), about $53-70**
- Android Central calls it the thinnest and lightest of the 2026 slim Qi2 banks it tested. It's 0.27" thick and 104g, with 22.5W wired output.
- The spec table lists wireless at only 7.5W, so it's the slowest wireless option here. Check the listing before buying.
- Details and Amazon pricing: https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge

**Best slim option with full iPhone 17 speed: INIU SnapGo Air (10,000mAh, 25W Qi2.2), about $43-49**
- It supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging, which the iPhone 17 can use, plus 45W wired charging. It includes a 60W lanyard-style cable.
- It's 0.5" thick and 195g, so it's thicker and heavier than the 5K models. Macworld lists INIU's SnapGo Air 10K as tied for the slimmest 10K MagSafe pack, and Android Central praised its value.
- Prices and reviews: https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge and https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html

**Other options**
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K, 15W, IP54 dust and water resistance):** about $70-80, 0.57" thick. It's the one to get if you want water resistance.
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10K, 25W Qi2.2, 45W wired):** $59.99, or $53.99 with code AM52 at Baseus's US store. Thickness wasn't listed, so I can't confirm it's slim. The link is an affiliate link: https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w

**How to choose**
- **Pocketability first:** Anker Nano 5K (best balance) or Baseus Picogo Air (thinnest, but slow wireless).
- **Two full charges and fastest speed:** INIU SnapGo Air 10K.
- **Case compatibility:** Anker notes that thick or non-magnetic cases can interfere with charging, so use a MagSafe-compatible case.
